For CVE Schema 5.0:  CVE_JSON_5.0_bundled.json was copied from https://github.com/CVEProject/cve-schema/blob/master/schema/v5.0/docs/CVE_JSON_5.0_bundled.json so that we can validate a CVE record's JSON content in our codebase.

For CVE Schema 5.1.0:  CVE_Record_Format_bundled.json was copied from https://github.com/CVEProject/cve-schema/blob/main/schema/docs/CVE_Record_Format_bundled.json so that we can validate a CVE record's JSON content in our codebase.
